TOPIC 10.5
Harmonic Series 
and p-Series

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

LIM-7.A
Determine whether a series 
converges or diverges.  
bc only

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

LIM-7.A.7
In addition to geometric series, common series 
of numbers include the harmonic series, the 
alternating harmonic series, and p-series. 
bc only

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

LIM-7
Applying limits may allow us to determine the finite sum of infinitely many terms.
